title: Chapter 139 - 139 Praise From Everyone; Red Packets!
content:
Chapter 139 - 139 Praise From Everyone; Red Packets!

Chapter 139 - 139 Praise from Everyone; Red Packets!

139 Praise from Everyone; Red Packets!

After People’s Daily published the news, everyone understood that they had been deceived earlier.

Fruit-Flavored Tangyuan: [Lin Fan, you’ve worked hard. Thank you!]

Strawberry: [Lin Fan, you’ve worked hard. Thank you!]

Loyalty: [Lin Fan, you’ve worked hard. Thank you!]

…

Last Stand: [Sunlight Scholar is really scheming! He even said that there were corpses piled up in Fu City. I checked and found that the photo of the corpse was actually a screenshot from the movie ‘War of Resistance!’ If you don’t believe me, you can go and take a look! The photo of the trampling is from the TV show ‘New Nobleman,’ and the photo of the traffic jam isn’t from Fu City at all!]

Wish: [Heavens! So this is the truth! We were all fooled by Sunlight Scholar!]

Everyone For Me: [I was wondering why I didn’t see any trampling or corpses when I was in Fu City.]

Fragrance to Fanghua: [Sunshine Scholar? Is he worthy of being called a scholar? Sunshine? Pah!]

Wang’s Woman: [I’ve long said that there’s something wrong with Sunshine Scholar. Why is it possible for foreigners to invent it, but we Hua Nation people definitely can’t? Are you so ready to worship our countries?]

Amidst everyone’s discussion, the authorities released evidence of Sunshine Scholar collecting fees from foreign organizations to cause conflicts. They also released the video of Li Jing crashing into an Audi after drinking at the bar that day, as well as evidence of Li Jing evading taxes.

Instantly, the entire internet was in an uproar.

Gift: [F*ck! I was wondering why Sunshine Scholar would publish such an article. It turns out he’s a scumbag!]

To Jun Moruo: [I must have been blind in the past to actually like Li Jing!]

Nature: [An actress actually scammed a scientist! We can’t let news of this out!]

Treasure: [We need to get rid of evil from its roots!]

…

Amidst everyone’s heated discussions, the earthquake finally arrived at 15:30 on January 2.

Rumble!

The entire city shook. A few old houses that had been in disrepair for a long time and were uninhabited fell to the ground with a loud bang. A ditch that was a few centimeters wide appeared on a muddy and dilapidated road.

Fu City was in an earthquake!

Fortunately, everyone in Fu City had received the notice and came to the open space in advance. Moreover, the magnitude of the earthquake was not high.

Therefore, there were no casualties!

Then, at 21:30 on January 2, a magnitude 5.1 earthquake occurred in Chuan City.

At 9:20 on January 3, a magnitude 3.5 earthquake occurred in Han City.

Every earthquake was predicted accurately. The earthquake prediction device was successfully developed, and it was accurate!

The entire country was in an uproar!

…

Lin Fan had no idea about all of this.

At this moment, he was lying alone in the Coiling Dragon Villa, fast asleep.

He had been accompanying Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling for the past three days.

Even though Lin Fan had Violent Aesthetics, which enhanced his body, three consecutive days still made him a little tired.

Since it was New Year’s, it was inevitable that the dormitory was a little noisy.

That was why he chose to rest in the Coiling Dragon Villa.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Hidden mission completed. Everyone is praising you. You’ve received five silver packets.]

Hearing this, Lin Fan, who had been sleeping for a long time, opened his eyes slowly. His face was filled with confusion.

“Praise? What is this?”

These days, he only cared about accompanying Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling, so he really did not know what had happened.

Lin Fan rubbed his nose and muttered, “Forget it, I don’t care. Let’s see what I can get first.”

[Do you wish to open the five silver packets?]

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 500,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received one Bugatti Veyron.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received Koenigsegg CCR1.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you have received 300,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10x Enhancement Potion x3.]

Lin Fan looked at the contents of the four silver packets and frowned. His face was filled with disappointment.

If other people found out, who knew what kind of expression they would have?

The Bugatti Veyron and Koenigsegg CCR were both supercars worth more than 20 million yuan.

However, Lin Fan was disappointed?

Then, Lin Fan locked his gaze on the 10x enhancement potions.

[10x enhancement potion: a special potion. After drinking it, it can increase one’s spirit, reaction speed, strength, and other aspects by ten times for 24 hours. It makes one stronger and faster, thus more charming.]

When Lin Fan saw this, his lips curled up.

This potion would make him ten times stronger immediately. This was definitely a good potion.

Lin Fan slowly raised his head. In front of him were two car keys. He walked out of the window. Other than the Mercedes-Benz, there were two more super sports cars outside.

However, Lin Fan had no intention of going downstairs to admire them.

Instead, he slowly picked up his phone.

[Do you wish to open 255 red packets?]

This was mainly the red packets that he had received from helping Qiu Ziqian and Huang Ling buy things on New Year’s Day.

“Yes!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained the skill doubling card.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 1,99 yuan.]

….

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received one yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a skill level upgrade card.]

…

With 255 red packets, Lin Fan received a total of 352,211 yuan.

Of course, money was not important.

More importantly, Lin Fan had also obtained the doubling skill card and the skill level upgrade card that he had always wanted!

To Lin Fan, these two items alone were worth more than five silver packets.

Could this be quantity over quality?

[Level: LV5]

[Level 5 reward: 20 yuan for every breath; 20 yuan for every second of sleep, and 20 yuan for every step taken. Rewards are distributed at 12 a.m. daily.]

[Upgrade cost: 10.05 million/50 million (not including gifts and gambling. In addition, all items obtained from the system are prohibited from being traded.]

[Skills: Professional Driving Skills, Charming Aura (5% chance of triggering love at first sight, unforgettable memory), Violent Aesthetics, Drinking Gentleman, Absolute Focus (10% chance of triggering a flash of inspiration), Professor-Level Mathematics Experience, Eyes of Truth… Professor-Level English, Professor-Level Chemistry Skills, Scanning]

[Funds: 221 million]

Lin Fan rubbed his chin and hesitated about what skill to level up.

At this moment, Lin Fan’s phone rang.

It was Lin Xiaoyao.

“Brother, I heard that Lin Fan from Jiangbei University invented an earthquake prediction device… That person… Could it be you?” Lin Xiaoyao asked as soon as she picked up the call.

Lin Fan was stunned, “How do you know that?”

“F*ck, it’s really you! Awesome!” Lin Xiaoyao shouted excitedly.
